reviewed_by: Claude review of the AGENTS.md symlink rule after a live project was refused
reason: The live imessage project links AGENTS.md to its parent program's AGENTS.md (../../AGENTS.md), which the first rule refused, blocking provider chats there. A symlink may now resolve inside the workspace or to an AGENTS.md in the workspace or one of its ancestor folders; links to other files or to AGENTS.md files in unrelated trees are still refused. The new test covers the shared-parent link and both rejection cases; the existing AGENTS.md tests and turn-preparation selections are kept.
exclusions: No full suites and no browser coverage: there is no UI change. Verified against the three real project workspaces on the Linux host (two with AGENTS.md, one via the shared parent link).
